spans.s:
ययाति (तिः) 2.
m. A monarch, the
fifth of the lunar race.

ययु (युः) 2.
m. A horse; one fit for
the
Aswamedha sacrifice.

यायजूक (कः) 1.
m. The performer
of frequent sacrifices.

यायावर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Going frequent-
ly.
m. A horse fit for the
Aswa-
medha sacrifice; the sage
Jurut-
kāru; a
brāhman; a mendicant;
alms not asked for.
